intro: This globe icon draws a sphere crossed by curved meridians and lines of latitude. On screen it stands for the world beyond one place: switching language or region, visiting a website, setting content to public or showing that a feature works internationally. You will most often find it in footers, headers and sharing settings.
meaning: Meridian lines make a circle read as Earth without drawing any continents, so the symbol feels neutral and works in every market. People connect it with the web, public visibility and multiple languages. It differs from a map, which means a specific area, and from a pin, which means one place. It also differs from wifi arcs, which are about the connection itself rather than where content reaches.
uses: Site header: opens the language and region selector so visitors switch content and currency in one place.
Social post composer: shows the post is visible to everyone, as opposed to friends only or private.
Contact card in a CRM: links to the company's site alongside phone and email details.
Desktop app settings page: labels network and proxy options that control how the app reaches the internet.
tips: Next to a language picker, show the current language name in text beside the globe, written in that language, such as Deutsch or Español.
At 16 px keep only two or three meridians; a dense grid of lines closes up and the globe looks like a ball of string.
When it means public visibility, add a tooltip or label like Anyone can see this, because that meaning is not obvious to everyone.

faq.q: What does the globe icon mean on a website?
faq.a: On a website the globe icon usually opens language or region settings, so you can switch content, currency or shipping country. In social apps it also marks posts that are public. If it sits next to a URL, it acts as a website icon linking to the company's site.

faq.q: Should I use a globe as the language icon?
faq.a: A globe works for language switching when paired with the current language name, which most people recognise. Flags are a poor alternative because one language spans many countries. Some products add a small letter A beside the globe so the translation meaning is clearer.
